source: Synthetic example (CAMARA publishes no open data; operators expose these APIs only to registered API consumers). Device identifiers are the CAMARA specification's own example values (phone number +123456789) or documentation addresses (RFC 5737 / RFC 3849); the Madrid scenario, times and figures are invented. Structure: CAMARA population-density-data 1.0.0, Apache-2.0, CAMARA Project (Linux Foundation).
